criteria.criterion: Every P1 line of the brief's worked example holds through the built binary, on temporary git repositories: the exact file bytes, the `wrote` / `updated` / `would write` / `would update` lines, no line and unchanged bytes when both entries are present, and exit 1 with `.claude/settings.json is not a JSON object — fix it, then re-run` (or `.claude/settings.json's <key> is not a JSON object — fix it, then re-run`, naming enabledPlugins or extraKnownMarketplaces) with no file changed.
criteria.evidence: internal/install/settings.go MergeClaudeSettings emits both messages; init_test.go and upgrade_test.go named tests (NoFileWrites, DryRun, KeepsBothEntries, Refuses...); the go check passed (go.log).

criteria.criterion: Merge rules: each entry is added only when its key is absent; an existing value is kept whatever it is (an `enabledPlugins["vloop@vloop"]: false` stays false, an existing `extraKnownMarketplaces.vloop` stays as it is); every other key at every level keeps its value and order; a new key goes at the end of its object, extraKnownMarketplaces before enabledPlugins when both are new at the top level. Violation: a key or value other than the two entries changed, reordered or dropped, or an existing false turned true.
criteria.evidence: settings.go uses an order-preserving node tree; get() == nil guards both adds; extraKnownMarketplaces is resolved before enabledPlugins; TestInitSettingsKeepsOptOutAndOwnMarketplace and ...MergesAfterTheKeysItKeeps.

criteria.criterion: When written, the file is laid out as json.MarshalIndent with "" and two spaces lays it out (an empty {} or [] inline), with HTML escaping off (`\u0026`, `\u003c`, `\u003e` written as themselves), numbers keeping their digits (1.50 stays 1.50, 12345678901234567890 stays as is), and a final newline; a file that is kept is not rewritten, so its bytes do not change.
criteria.evidence: settings.go write(), UseNumber decoding, SetEscapeHTML(false), a trailing newline, and an early return of existing when !changed; TestInitSettingsLayoutKeepsNumbersAndText.

criteria.criterion: No file: it is created holding the two entries and nothing else, with .claude/ created if missing. init reports `wrote`, `updated` or `kept .claude/settings.json` after the CLAUDE.md step (`would write` / `would update` / `would keep` on --dry-run, which writes nothing); upgrade reports `updated .claude/settings.json` when it wrote the file, nothing when it kept it, and `would update .claude/settings.json` on --dry-run and on the breaking path before --yes; upgrade's `already at <v>` return is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: init.go step 6 uses mergedStep after CLAUDE.md; upgrade.go appends a change only when changed and reuses the existing would-update and updated paths; tests TestUpgradeSettingsDryRunAndBreakingPathOnlySayWouldUpdate and TestUpgradeSettingsKeepsAFileWithBothEntriesSilently. The early return was not touched.

criteria.criterion: A file that is not a JSON object (invalid JSON, an array, a string), or whose enabledPlugins or extraKnownMarketplaces is present but not an object, is refused with exit 1 and the message above: by init before any step writes and before any would-line on --dry-run; by upgrade before any file is written, on --dry-run and on the breaking path too, before any `would update` line. A symlinked .claude/settings.json is refused as the other targets are (checkRepoPath).
criteria.evidence: Both init.go and upgrade.go merge and return Problem(err) before any write or would-line is produced; TestInitSettingsRefusesWhatIsNotAnObject, TestUpgradeSettingsRefusesWhatIsNotAnObjectBeforeAnyWrite, and the two ...RefusesSymlink tests.

criteria.criterion: Nothing is written outside the repository and no `claude plugin` or `copilot plugin` command is run by init or upgrade. No new module dependency.
criteria.evidence: The diff uses writeRepoFile within the repo and only stdlib imports in settings.go; no exec calls; go mod tidy is part of the check and passed.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests in internal/cli's init and upgrade tests hold each P1 worked-example line as a named test on a temporary git repository (addressed with git -C), plus the merge-rule cases above; the `go` check runs them. Violation: the merge shipped with no committed test the check runs.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/init_test.go (+131 lines) and upgrade_test.go (+98 lines) with the named tests listed above; go.log shows ok.

criteria.criterion: Existing tests change only where the brief's Constraints allow: tests pinning init's or upgrade's output lines gain the new .claude/settings.json line, and TestDoctorGateEditsNoClaudeAndWritesNothing asserts the only file under .claude/ is settings.json holding the two entries.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/b5_e2e_test.go changes only the line count 17→18 and adds the `wrote .claude/settings.json` line; doctor_test.go was adjusted for the doctor gate test.
